kind.description: overdue-digest: each person's overdue or stuck records; daily-digest: what needs attention, to members who manage the workspace; custom: a handler added in src/jobs/digests.ts. Optional: inferred from `what` (overdue → overdue-digest; digest, summary or daily report → daily-digest; otherwise custom).

cron.description: Five-field cron in the job's time zone, e.g. "0 7 * * *" (every morning at 07:00).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Madrid; null = UTC.

logWhenNoEmailProvider.description: Without RESEND_API_KEY emails are logged (always true in practice: the email component logs them).
